description: Add a post to the evergreen queue pool. Either add an existing post by ID or create a new evergreen post with text content.

cooldown_days.description: Custom cooldown days for this post (overrides default)

post_id.description: ID of an existing post to add to the evergreen pool

text.description: Text for a new evergreen post (if not using post_id)

x_account_id.description: Target X account ID (for multi-account users)

name: opentweet_add_to_evergreen
